statement: For the declared onsite J_b detector, nominal completed outputs are (1-exp(-kappa T))P_b rho P_b and wait has exp(-kappa T)rho. On the actual shared-bath CPTP evolution, joint incomplete-pointer effects obey subset<=p(T)^|S|, p(T)^q=exp(-q kappa T)+(C eta/kappa)(1-exp(-q kappa T)); completion independence is not assumed. Forward-Dyson exceptional-site SYSTEM legs retain arbitrary bath coefficients and local output effects. Below the CSS/queue radius every grouped physical outcome has the correct logical label and no logical off-diagonal input. The signed comparison may have real negative c_l; actual CPTP trace normalization gives full-instrument error<=2(delta_in+delta_wait+delta_D), independent of logical dimension. Separate finite pointer reset-to-wait preparation allows coherent wrong pointers, conservatively charging BOTH ket/bra sets as 2beta_0 N. The final excessive-wait event is classical and costs its probability; preparation projections are analytical and pay gentle errors. Full generic k-bit logical coordinates cost O(N²), not the O(N) queue bound.
